captions.detailed: This 3D model features a pair of aviation pilot binoculars with a dark, rubber-armored finish. It consists of two long, wide cylindrical objective tubes connected by a central hinge bridge, and two smaller eyepieces at the rear. The lenses on both ends are tinted a reflective blue-grey. The central hinge allows for revolving adjustment to change the distance between the tubes, while each eyepiece focus ring can rotate continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of aviation pilot binoculars. The binoculars should feature two thick, cylindrical objective tubes connected by a central hinge bridge. The central hinge should allow for a revolute joint to adjust the interpupillary distance, and each eyepiece focus ring should have a continuous rotational joint. Apply a dark grey or black rubberized material to the body and a reflective blue-grey color to the glass lenses.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly consisting of a central hinge pin (base link) and two main optical tube assemblies (left and right). Each optical tube is built using nested Cylinder primitives representing the main objective barrel, tapered sections, and the eyepiece. The ribbed grip on the barrels is created by subtracting or unioning multiple small box/cylinder cuts, and the lenses are modeled as thin cylinders placed inside the barrels. The assembly is wired together using revolute joints connecting the left and right optical tubes to the central hinge, allowing for interpupillary adjustment.
